facts.fact: The World Bank's March 2023 regional brief says 'the 2020 Smart Rwanda Masterplan is dated' while Rwanda follows a whole-of-government approach to public-sector digital transformation; it gives no end date or successor, and the 'expired' value rests on the plan's 2020 name and the word 'dated'.

The brief says the Rwanda Information Society Authority (RISA, established in 2017) is responsible for planning and coordinating implementation of the national ICT for Development Agenda; it states no budget line, and the text does not say that agenda is the Masterplan.
